title: Northpeak 'Ashfall' game trailer
description: Game trailer dialogue. Northpeak licenses Theo Rusk, but not Silas Orne.
transcript: Stay behind me. The bridge won't hold us both if we run. Shields are down to 40%. We need to retreat now. Traveller, you look tired. Sit by the fire and tell me where you have come from. You found the silver key. Maybe it opens the door in the east tower. He counted the steps to the top of the tower. There were exactly 212.
